title: Terrain ruggedness cost for mountain-lion corridors
method: 30 m DEM (EPSG:26911, m). Ruggedness = 3x3 focal RANGE ignoring NoData (max = 223.39 m, identical to the upper threshold hard-coded in the benchmark's model). Cost = Rescale by Function MSLarge (mean and std multipliers 1, thresholds 0-223.39) on an evaluation scale from 10 to 1, so flat terrain = 10 and rugged terrain -> 1. Both rasters written as GeoTIFF on the DEM grid.
benchmark_defects: The benchmark distributes only Elevation.tfw/.aux.xml for this task; the DEM is taken from the Learn ArcGIS mountain-lion project. The distributed Elevation.tif.aux.xml holds statistics of an unrelated 0-255 multi-band image.

The instruction does not state the focal statistic (domain knowledge describes TRI, the model uses RANGE), the rescale function or its direction; the checks accept any terrain-variation statistic and either direction, reporting the choices of the benchmark's model separately.
'standardize' admits z-scores; bounded 0-100 cost or z-scores accepted.
checks: required: ruggedness (file or captured 2-D array) rank-correlates with gold 3x3 range (|Spearman| >= 0.95)
required: cost raster saved with the DEM CRS and footprint (bounds IoU >= 0.95)
required: cost is a standardised monotone transform of ruggedness (|Spearman| >= 0.85, values within [0,100] or z-scores, >= 90 % coverage)
optional: rugged terrain gets low cost (original direction)
optional: MSLarge rescale named in code
required: DEM NoData kept as NoData in the cost raster (>= 90 %)
